description: One-defect .plytab documents, each with how the reader must treat it: 'newer' (refused as written by a newer Ply, from the envelope alone; schema_version is the version it reports), 'wrong_format' (not a tablet weaving band), 'malformed' (not readable as this version), 'too_large' (past a count limit) or 'opens' (readable; validation reports its errors). Written by hand from the reading rules of ADR 0018 section 14 and its M10-02 amendments.

cases.tests: schema version 2: refused as newer before its document (with a field this build does not know) is read
schema version 37 whose document is not an object at all: still refused as newer, not as unreadable
another Ply format (a knitting pattern's envelope)
the engine's band shape with no envelope: a .plytab has no legacy, unversioned form
schema_version 0 is not a positive integer
schema_version written as a string
an envelope without a document
an envelope key this version does not write
a document key this version does not write
a card key this version does not write (a tilt-named threading)
a threading that is neither S nor Z
a card whose hole D is left out (an empty hole is written as null, never left out)
a document without its notes (always written, empty or not)
a key written twice
a JSON array around the envelope
not JSON at all
a pick note kind that is neither brocade nor other
a turn string of 4,001 letters: longer than any band of at most 1,000 cards can use, refused before the editor holds it
a start with two diagonal holes on one edge: a structural error that validation reports, so the document opens (and saves as a draft)
a pick giving the words for one card twice: refused, never reduced to the last words (a save would otherwise drop the first)
